content.title: Mapping the Next Phase: Updating the Cloud Native Maturity Model for 2025, The AI Era and Beyond
content.author: Danielle Cook, Simon Forster, Robert Glenn
content.summary: The session presents the latest update to the CNCF Cloud Native Maturity Model, highlighting how organizations can assess and accelerate their cloud‑native adoption in the AI era, with focus on security, platform engineering, and developer experience. Attendees help shape the model’s future, making it a practical benchmark for transformation initiatives.
content.description:

content.author: Ajay Sundar Karuppasamy
